  once, maybe, but no longer true.

  dried fruit to last the day. She walked in whatever direction seemed most likely to yield something worth recording. Some days it was north, toward
  the salt flats that had been a lake in her grandmother's time. Some days it was west, into the hills where new streams had carved paths through old
  rock.
